description: Agent Real Estate: submit a property listing as presented with the record behind it: the listing with its street address, unit, postal code, parcel number, price and currency, living and lot area in square feet, bedrooms, bathrooms, status (active, coming soon, pending, under contract, sold, leased, withdrawn or off market) and availability date; the record with the same fields as recorded, where it comes from (such as the county assessor or the recorded deed) and the day it was made; optionally the policy with the share an area may differ from the record and the days after which the record is stale; and the day the records are read on. The signed report gives both sides, the street, unit, postal code and parcel each read as matching, differing or unread, the listed and recorded price with the difference, the living and lot area with each difference as a share of the record against the tolerance, the bedrooms and bathrooms, and the status and availability date on each side, and counts the fields compared and matched, and names a misstated listing: an address or parcel unlike the record, a price unlike the recorded one, more living area than recorded past the tolerance, more bedrooms or bathrooms than recorded, and the property offered as active or coming soon while the record shows it pending, under contract, sold, leased, withdrawn or off market; then less living area past the tolerance, a lot unlike the record, fewer rooms, another status, another availability date and a record older than the policy allows, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A record with no address or parcel, no price or no status, a listed area or room count the record does not state, areas that differ with no tolerance, or a record age policy with no record date or day read on leaves the listing unverified. Streets are read with their common abbreviations spelled out, so 27 Alder Ln and 27 Alder Lane are one street. This reads a property listing against an independent record: wever_listing-check reads a product listing as submitted for missing fields, image reachability and price sanity against its own stated attributes, not against a property record, and wever_vendor-price-consistency-check reads a service vendor’s price across its quote, listing and invoice. Verdict realty_listing_misstated, realty_listing_partial, realty_listing_unverified or realty_listing_accurate. POST /api/realty-listing-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.
